scope: RTX path tracer physically based materials; no compatibility gate closes

nopack-cand.lights: 113 light entities and 2 glowing shaders over 50 triangles

runs.mergedSnapshot: shared tree with the animated-surfaces session plus this round, 3-way merged: glx, vk, rtx built under /W4 /WX; both rounds' tests passed

retailCollisions._light: q3 4, ql 2, rtcw 1, stvef 1, jka 7, jk2 2, fakk2 1

suffixCensus._emissive: one pair, in the Steam install's community netpack (rq3dm5_dyson), none in retail paks

tests: tests/rtx_pbr_material_tests.py and 78 other affected files (RTX, shader parsers, assets, changelog, docs, player manual): all pass

references.OpenJK rend2: https://github.com/JACoders/OpenJK/tree/1a6a643427aa347553e9073dac5570b33337c4d9 (codemp/rd-rend2 tr_shader.cpp, tr_image.cpp, glsl/lightall.glsl), reference observation only

limits: parallax shifts the primary view only; no self-shadowing
maps belong to one stage of a lit material
no Q2RTX-style override files; shader scripts are the material system
not measured: other profiles with a pack, frame time with maps, a third-party rend2 pack

q3dm1Conversion.scope: derived maps for every image q3dm1 lit materials draw; kept in .tmp, never committed (invariant 8)
q3dm1Conversion.probe: .tmp/rtx-pbr-q3dm1/probe.sh: retail q3dm1, five views, plain vs PBR after vid_restart, compute backend, win32-dev b27921b1 plus the parallax fade
q3dm1Conversion.engineChange: parallax fades out between 63 and 81 degrees from the normal
